name: Glass Aurora
description: Dark hero with soft aurora gradient glows behind a backdrop-blur glass panel. Eyebrow, headline, subtitle and two CTAs, with a CSS-only entrance rise and a slow floating glow.

name: Editorial Gradient
description: Bold light hero led by a large editorial headline with gradient text over a soft mesh-gradient background. Single primary CTA and a gentle bouncing scroll cue, all CSS-only.

name: Shape Landing
description: Dark hero with softly glowing geometric shapes that drop in, settle and float behind the content. Eyebrow pill, two-line headline whose second line carries a primary-to-accent gradient, subtitle and CTAs, all entering with a staggered CSS-only fade-up. Adapted from KokonutUI's Shape Hero (21st.dev: kokonutd/shape-landing-hero, MIT).

name: Sparkle Stats
description: Centered minimal hero with a sparkle eyebrow pill, two-line headline whose second line fades via a gradient, subtitle, CTA pair (primary carries an arrow that nudges on hover), and an optional stats row with hairline dividers (data.stats: [{ value, label }]). Everything enters with a staggered CSS-only fade-up; palette-neutral so it works on light or dark themes. Adapted from 21st.dev: moumensoliman/hero-section-shadcnui (MIT).
